title: Matthew Bevan's 1990s hacks

tellings.quote: and yeah, and he was earlier. He was in the ' 90s

plain: A British computer hacker named Gary McKinnon, who says he found signs of a secret space programme while breaking into NASA computers, mentions another hacker named Matthew Bevan. McKinnon says Bevan came earlier, doing his own hacking in the 1990s, with the story tied to the UK and the US Department of Energy, the government agency that runs America's nuclear and energy work.
